title: MANIBELA cancels third day of protest, but strike to continue
summary: Transport group Samahang Manibela, Mananakay at Nagkaisang Terminal ng Transportasyon (MANIBELA) on Wednesday canceled its supposed third day of protest due to inclement weather.

blocks.text: Members of MANIBELA in front of the Land Transportation Office on East Avenue, Quezon City during their transport strike on Monday, Nov. 24, 2026. GMA News
Transport group Samahang Manibela, Mananakay at Nagkaisang Terminal ng Transportasyon (MANIBELA) on Wednesday canceled its supposed third day of protest due to inclement weather.
However, MANIBELA national president Mar Valbuena said that their strike will continue.
"Re-sched po namin ang protest malakas ang ulan pero tigil pasada padin kami," he said in a message to GMA News Online.
(We will reschedule the protest. The rains are heavy but we will continue with our strike.)
MANIBELA began its strike and protest on Monday following the change in leadership in the Land Transportation Office (LTO).
The group earlier said that it would be better for then incumbent LTO chief Markus Lacanilao to remain at his post to continue what he started.

On Tuesday, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. appointed Lacanilao as the new Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA) administrator. He will be succeeded by Noreen Bernadette San Luis at the LTO. —KG, GMA News
